field.label: Client IP from
field.comment: Behind a proxy, Varnish or CDN REMOTE_ADDR is the proxy. Only choose a header your own proxy sets, otherwise visitors can fake it. Compare with "Your IP as seen by the shop" above.

field.label: Never block these IPs
field.comment: One IP or CIDR range per line (office, ERP, monitoring). Text after # is a comment.

group.label: Request filter
group.comment: Checked before Magento handles the request. Pages delivered from Varnish or a CDN never reach PHP and are not filtered. For the admin area and API calls with a token only the IP lists apply.

field.label: Block attack patterns
field.comment: StyleSmuggler, TrojanOrder template directives, PHP code in parameters, CosmicSting XXE, PHP2Shell upload progress fields, scanner sign-ups. The sender IP is banned by the bot scan.

field.label: Load new attack patterns from Storetown Media
field.comment: Every hour the shop fetches a signed list of attack patterns from storetown-media.de, so new attack waves are filtered before the next module update. Only the file is fetched, nothing about your shop is sent. A list that is not signed by Storetown Media is never used. Status: bin/magento shopguard:rules

field.label: Block password guessing on the admin login
field.comment: Magento locks an account after a few failed logins, but the address keeps trying other accounts. This blocks the address until the end of the next day. Addresses that logged in to the admin in the last 30 days, "Never block these IPs" and proxy addresses are never blocked.

field.label: Card test brake
field.comment: Card testers run stolen card numbers through the checkout, one payment attempt after the other. Counted are payment attempts per address and hour (REST payment-information, GraphQL placeOrder, checkouts with placeOrder in the address). Start with "Watch only" and check bin/magento shopguard:cardtests after a week: if no real customer appears there, switch to refusing. Admin addresses and proxies are never counted.

field.label: Payment attempts per address and hour
field.comment: Above this number the address is noted or refused.

field.label: Block after failed admin logins
field.comment: Failed logins from one address within 15 minutes.

field.label: Block file uploads in product options
field.comment: PolyShell (APSB25-94). Set on install if your catalog has no options of type "File". Keep it on unless you sell products with customer uploads.

field.label: Block customer address file uploads
field.comment: /customer/address_file/upload is used to drop files for SessionReaper. Set on install if no customer or address attribute of type file or image exists.

field.label: Block GraphQL
field.comment: Emergency switch while a GraphQL vulnerability is unpatched. Luma and most Hyvä shops work without it; PWA, Hyvä Checkout and some apps need it. Test checkout after enabling.

field.label: Block SEO tool crawlers
field.comment: Ahrefs, Semrush, Majestic, DotBot, DataForSEO, PetalBot and others. Search engines are never affected.

field.label: Block AI training crawlers
field.comment: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Bytespider, meta-externalagent, Amazonbot and others. AI search and user agents (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Claude-User) stay allowed.

field.label: Blocked IPs
field.comment: One IP or CIDR range per line. Text after # is a comment.

field.label: Blocked user agents
field.comment: One part of the user agent per line, not case sensitive, e.g. "scrapy".

field.label: Protect filter parameters
field.comment: Optional. One URL parameter of the layered navigation per line, e.g. "color" or "price". Filter URLs are then only served to visitors with a running session or coming from your own pages; search engines are allowed. Against scraper networks that crawl every filter combination. Empty = off.

group.label: Bot scan
group.comment: Every hour Shop Security Guard evaluates a sample of the requests and adds attackers, bots and fake search engine crawlers to the lists below. Each entry carries its expiry date and can be edited or removed.

field.label: Bot threshold (requests per hour)
field.comment: A bot or HTTP library user agent above this rate is blocked.

field.label: IP threshold (requests per hour)
field.comment: A single IP above this rate is blocked for one day. Verified search engines are excluded.

field.label: Sample 1 of N requests
field.comment: Attacks are always recorded. Raise for very busy shops.

field.label: Automatically blocked IPs
field.comment: Written by the bot scan. Format: IP # expiry date and reason.

field.label: Automatically blocked user agents
field.comment: Written by the bot scan. Delete a line to unblock.

group.label: Backdoor scan
group.comment: Every 30 minutes: PHP files and disguised images in pub/media and pub/static, unknown PHP files in pub/ and its subdirectories, PHP code hidden in other file types, locked directories, attack code in var/report and logs (StyleSmuggler), disguised processes, crontab entries, injected scripts in CMS and configuration, new admin users and integrations, and every code file in vendor, app, lib, setup and bin against a reference state (new, changed, deleted). Contents of unchanged files are checked weekly.

field.label: Write .user.ini
field.comment: Creates pub/media/.user.ini and pub/static/.user.ini with "engine = Off". PHP-FPM then refuses to run uploaded scripts there, also on nginx. Existing files are never overwritten.

field.label: Allowed extra PHP files in pub/
field.comment: File name or path below pub/ per line (file.php, opt/file.php), optionally followed by its SHA-256 hash (sha256sum pub/file.php). With hash, any change is reported.

field.label: Send alerts to
field.comment: Comma separated. Mail only on findings, the same findings are repeated once a day at most. Critical findings also appear in the admin inbox.
